## Catalog change

Briefly describe the model or metadata correction and cite the primary source.

## Checklist

- [ ] The entry learns directly from raw DNA or RNA sequence and meets `docs/SCHEMA.md`.
- [ ] The model family, paper and aliases are not already present.
- [ ] The earliest public date and later publication date are distinguished.
- [ ] Paper, code and weights links are official where possible.
- [ ] Unknown metadata uses YAML `null`; no values were guessed.
- [ ] `python generate_paper_list.py` and `python scripts/validate_data.py` pass.
- [ ] Generated `README.md`, `assets/model_timeline.svg`, and `assets/model_evolution_tree.svg` are committed.
